== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Blaster Rifle with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806160841/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/blasterrifle.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Blaster Rifle (Dark) (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/3b/Premiere-D-blasterrifledark-PC-Errata-disc.gif Internet Archive item].
